xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfAuditQualificationExp:
The Statutory auditors have reported the following in their Report on the Internal Financial Controls under Clause (i) of Sub-section 3 of Section 143 of the Companies Act, 2013 (The Act)

The Logistics Services of Northern Region did not have an adequate internal control system in place for processing payments. This weakness could result in payments being made without proper verification of the authenticity of vendor invoices.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ReasonsIfManagementIsUnableToE: Since it refers to an Internal Control Weakness, the same cannot be quantified.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:AuditorsCommentsOnManagementsE: We endorse the comments of the management in (i) and (ii) above
